messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT: P1 — spike in 502/504 at api-gateway (edge/gateway tier). 502 rate 8% over last 5m, latency up. Auto-pager engaged. Please acknowledge in this thread.

alex (oncall): Ack, I'm taking lead. Adding @lia and @prateek. Starting triage.

lia (sre): On it — pulling metrics and proxy health. Which region first?

alex (oncall): eu-west-1 shows highest error rates per dashboard.

prateek (eng-runtime): Noted. Any recent config changes to the gateway or proxy? I see a proxy-config rollout ~50m ago for keepalive tuning (rollout id: r-20240612-04). Could be related.

maria (support): Customer reports: AcmeCorp and NovaApp both hitting 502s on /v1/generate. Support got ~12 high-priority tickets in last 10m.

lia (sre): Quick checks:
- k8s ingress pods healthy? some are CrashLooping (3/6 ready on apigw-eu-west-1).
- backend pool connection errors increasing.

jessie (oncall): Repro: curl -I https://api.eu-west.redwood.example/v1/health\HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2024 22:03:45 GMT

ops-bot: Automated note: circuit-breaker policy triggered for upstream pool apigw-backend-eu-west at 22:03:12 UTC.

prateek (eng-runtime): Thanks. Lia, can you grab the proxy logs for the failing pods? commands: 
```kubectl -n gateway get pods -l app=apigw -o wide
kubectl -n gateway logs <pod> --since=10m | grep -i "upstream" -A3```

lia (sre): Logs show repeated "connection reset by peer" and 502 responses with upstream ECONNRESET. Sample: 
```[2024-06-12T22:02:33Z] proxy: upstream apiserver-01 failed: connection reset
[2024-06-12T22:02:34Z] proxy: returning 502 to client```

prateek (eng-runtime): That looks like backend pool exhaustion or a bad keepalive change. Rolling back the keepalive tuning to previous config on a single canary node to validate.

alex (oncall): Do rollback on-canary, then scale pool. Lia, please increase apigw backend pool size (+50%) and drop connection timeout to 30s as temporary mitigation.

lia (sre): Scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment apigw-backend --replicas=12 -n gateway`. Also set connection timeout override in envoy config and restart pods gracefully.

maria (support): Notifying affected customers: message posted to AcmeCorp and NovaApp support threads — we said we are investigating and applying mitigation.

prateek (eng-runtime): I pushed a rollback for proxy-config r-20240612-04 on one node (canary). Monitoring that canary for 2m. If stable, we'll roll further.

ops-bot: Telemetry update: 5m 502 rate dropped from 8% -> 3.5% after scaling and canary rollback.

lia (sre): Canary looks healthy, no more upstream resets in logs for that pod for 90s. Proceeding with progressive rollback across nodes.

alex (oncall): Switch routing to fallback region for high-latency customers if errors persist. But wait for current rollback effect.

maria (support): Customers updated: AcmeCorp acknowledges, will monitor. No escalations to legal.

prateek (eng-runtime): Rolling back config to r-20240610-12 across EU gateway pool now. Expected rolling restart ~4m.

lia (sre): Rolling restarts in progress. Current readiness: 10/12 pods ready. Error rate now 1.1% (5m).

ops-bot: Pager: circuit-breaker cleared for apigw-backend-eu-west at 22:07:18 UTC.

jessie (oncall): Quick perf note: token-per-request spiky patterns coincide with user bursts — added a short-term request-rate cap at the gateway for anonymous traffic.

alex (oncall): Good. Let's keep temporary rate limits and the rolled-back config until end of day. Create an incident ticket and postmortem owner.

maria (support): Done — created INC-20240612-APIGW-502 (owner: prateek). Added customer-impact notes.

prateek (eng-runtime): Monitoring steady. 5xx baseline back to 0.6% over last 10m. No backend restarts observed.

lia (sre): I'll keep an eye on connection pool metrics overnight and follow up in #eng-runtime in the morning.

alex (oncall): Thanks team. I'm closing the live triage but keeping incident open for postmortem. If anyone sees error rate creep >1.5% re-alert here.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Status: mitigated -> monitoring. Root cause suspected: keepalive/proxy tuning change led to upstream connection resets and circuit-breaker trips. Postmortem assigned.

prateek (eng-runtime): Quick action items captured:
- revert probe and keepalive changes (done)
- retro on rollout process for gateway configs
- add synthetic checks for 502 spikes pre-rollout

alex (oncall): Closing live channel. Thank you. :thumbsup:
